NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Prior Case record
Recorded at Approval on January 10, 2026.
This invented case is test data, not evidence about a real issuer.
Decision: Neutral action bias with Medium confidence on the Northbridge Term Loan.
Decision-maker role: Investment Committee.
Portfolio posture and position size were not recorded.
Thesis as decided: The credit is sound on reported figures and the single dealer quotation sits just below par.
Greatest uncertainty as decided: Thin market evidence from one dealer quotation.

NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Prior Case record: figures and expectations
This invented case is test data, not evidence about a real issuer.
Total leverage recorded at Approval on January 10, 2026 was 1.67x.
Interest cover recorded at Approval on January 10, 2026 was 6.00x.
Dealer quotation recorded at Approval, as of January 9, 2026: bid 98.50 and offer 99.25, expressed as a percentage of par.
Expectation recorded: leverage and cover to stay near these levels and the quotation to hold.
Downside paths named: weaker unaudited earnings, sized as total leverage above 1.75x or interest cover below 5.75x; and liquidity that depends on steady cash generation.
Exit trigger recorded: a sharp move in the quotation. No threshold was recorded.
Expected spread or return, expected rating path and expected holding period were not recorded.

SYNTHETIC LOAN MARKET DESK
Secondary loan quotation sheet
Published April 30, 2026. Quotations are as of the close on April 29, 2026.
This invented case is test data, not evidence about a real issuer.
Instrument: Northbridge Term Loan, the senior secured term loan of Northbridge Synthetic Group, with final maturity on December 31, 2029.

consistency_with_frozen_sources: Prior Case record page:2 total leverage 1.67x is the frozen LTM Q4 2025 total_leverage_reported 5/3 shown to two places (cases/financial/manifest.json q4_ltm_metric_oracle); interest cover 6.00x is the frozen 6
Prior Case record page:2 dealer quotation bid 98.50 and offer 99.25 as of January 9, 2026 equals the frozen market sheet page:1 (cases/cp3-cp6-owner/manifest.json market_source, sha256 c175d14b...)
Instrument name, senior secured term loan and final maturity December 31, 2029 in the later sheet equal the frozen sheet page:1 and financial page:5

The decision (Neutral, Medium, thesis, single dealer quotation just below par) is consistent with, but does not depend on, the CP-6 oracle draft (cases/cp3-cp6-owner); that file is not read for its CP-6 content
All outcome figures (1.80x, 5.50x, bid 98.00, offer 98.75) are dated after the frozen period (March 31 and April 29, 2026) and contradict no frozen figure

The pre-decision comparative on update page:1 (twelve months to December 31, 2025, 1.67x) is the same frozen LTM Q4 2025 leverage as the Prior Case record; it exists so the validator's rule that a realized observation must be dated after the decision is reachable (refusal r12); the line 'No default or restructuring had occurred as of December 31, 2025.' beside it makes the same rule reachable for the default statement (refusal r57) without also failing the subject rule (r60)

The update note's line 'Total leverage for the twelve months to February 28, 2026 was reported as 1.70x.' is invented; it is used only by refusal r68 (a realized figure that does not breach the recorded size) and by no accepted literal

The sizes named in the Prior Case record's downside line (total leverage above 1.75x, interest cover below 5.75x) are invented; Python (breach_of, strictly beyond the level) decides the breach: 1.80x and 5.50x breach them, the expected 1.67x and 6.00x do not, and the fixtures fixture_unchanged, fixture_improved and fixture_not_breached (1.70x; 5.75x equal to the level) do not (asserted)
